alternativeMaxCredits.scope: No separate ACE/NCCRS ceiling was found for this program; the overall 113-credit transfer ceiling still applies. An unknown cap is not treated as unlimited.

gradePolicy.detail: C or better for University, General Education and Major Core requirements; D or better for Arts and Sciences electives and electives. Outside credit needs at least the equivalent of C- and is posted as Pass.

graduationRequirements.title: Overall GPA

graduationRequirements.title: Liberal arts and sciences credits
graduationRequirements.description: Bachelor of Science degrees need at least 60 credits in the liberal arts and sciences; general education and arts and sciences electives count toward it.

notes: $510 per credit hour is the standard undergraduate tuition; Academic Services ($40 per credit hour) and Technology ($28 per course credit) fees are charged per Excelsior course credit, plus a one-time $125 graduation fee.
Partner tuition ($460 per credit on the Sophia partnership page) requires partner eligibility and brings the 15-Excelsior-credit partnership rule.
exclusions: Course materials, the optional $300 post-admission credit evaluation, the 2.85% card service fee and graduation regalia are not included.

modelFields.coverageLabel: Complete 120-credit Bachelor of Science in Liberal Arts (No Concentration) ledger from the November 2026 catalog, with outside options from Excelsior’s published Sophia, Study.com and StraighterLine equivalency guides.

curriculumSections.title: Upper-level electives (part of the 59 elective credits)

rulesNotes: Credit units are semester credits throughout; Excelsior counts one unit of credit as one semester credit.

Outside options come only from Excelsior’s own partner equivalency guides (Sophia March 2025; Study.com and StraighterLine December 2024). Guide rows whose Sophia course code differs from Sophia’s current syllabus are held as candidates, not options.

Distribution slots for natural science and mathematics accept outside courses that Excelsior’s guide classifies in that area. Other general education slots list only outside courses that Excelsior equates to the named Excelsior course or required topic.
Elective blocks list only outside courses that Excelsior equates to a named Excelsior course, so the receiving course is explicit.
Standard enrollment needs 7 Excelsior credits (INL 102, IND 101 and the capstone); partnership enrollment after December 31, 2024 needs at least 15 Excelsior course credits.
No separate ACE/NCCRS (non-collegiate) credit ceiling was found for this program; it remains unknown rather than unlimited.
unresolved: The 10-year transfer-credit time limit in Excelsior’s partner guides conflicts with the Grade Scale, GPA, and Credit Application policy statement that there is generally no time limit.
